title: Sri Maha Ganapathi Homam
summary: Removes all obstacles and invokes auspicious beginnings for ventures, weddings, business inaugurations, and new residences.

title: Gruhapravesam & Vastu Homam
summary: A comprehensive purification ceremony for new apartments and homes, including Go Pooja, Ganapathi, Navagraha, and Vastu Shanthi.

title: Navagraha Shanti Homam
summary: A homam dedicated to the nine celestial bodies, traditionally requested for Sade Sati and Rahu-Ketu doshams, and for health, harmony, and career growth.

title: Sri Ayushya Homam
summary: Conducted for first birthdays or the birthdays of elders, with prayers for longevity (Ayur Vriddhi), vital energy, and protection from severe illnesses.

title: Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Vratham
summary: Performed on full-moon days or special occasions to invite Mahavishnu's blessings, domestic harmony, and career breakthroughs.

title: Sashtiapthapoorthi (60th) & Bheemaratha Shanthi
summary: A Vedic marriage renewal and rejuvenation ceremony marking the completion of 60 years, with Kalasa abhishekam using consecrated waters.
inclusions: Mangalya Dharanam and Swarna Dana Vidhi
